metadata.title: Overview | Formula Operations
career.name: Career name
career.emptyBody: Create a Career from a source database to start your own independent world.
career.listBody: Each Career is an independent saved world. Choose one to continue.
career.newBody: Choose a database, season and participating team. Their current content will be copied into a new saved world.
career.snapshotNotice: Later changes to the source database will not change this Career.
career.noSourcesBody: A source database with a season and participating teams is required before a Career can be created.
career.noTeams: This season has no participating teams. Choose another season.
career.storageBody: Your saved Careers could not be loaded. Try again when the database is connected.
career.worldNotice: Career-owned data. Source database edits do not update this world.
career.noEventBody: There are no upcoming calendar events in this Career season.
career.selectSaved: Choose or create a Career. The panels below are the standalone development preview.
career.error.INVALID_NAME: Enter a Career name between 1 and 80 characters.
career.error.INVALID_ID: One of the selected identifiers is invalid. Please select the options again.
career.error.DATABASE_NOT_FOUND: The selected source database no longer exists.
career.error.SEASON_NOT_FOUND: Choose a season belonging to the selected database.
career.error.TEAM_NOT_PARTICIPATING: Choose a team participating in the selected season.
career.error.INVALID_SOURCE: The selected season contains inconsistent roster or calendar data. A Career was not created.
career.error.PERSISTENCE_FAILED: The database operation failed. Please try again after the connection is restored.
progression.calendarBody: No new season is generated. This Career remains available.
progression.notice: Practice and Qualifying use temporary development completion. New races support tyres, track interaction and pit strategy; older saves keep their original rules. No championship points are awarded.
progression.notEntered: This weekend has not been entered. Advance from the Career dashboard.
progression.error.NOT_FOUND: Career, event or session was not found.
progression.error.INVALID_TRANSITION: This action is no longer available. Refresh to see the current session.
progression.error.ACTIVE_WEEKEND: Finish the active weekend before advancing.
progression.error.CALENDAR_COMPLETE: There are no upcoming events in this season.
progression.error.STALE_EVENT: The next event changed. Refresh before advancing.
progression.error.PERSISTENCE_FAILED: The transition could not be saved. Please try again.
race.title: Race Simulation
race.notice: Development free-air model. Grid and performance profiles are temporary roster-based inputs. No tyres, traffic/overtaking, pit stops, weather or failures.
race.ready: Ready to snapshot inputs and start the Race.
race.unavailable: This session cannot start a Race. Legacy development completions have no classification.
race.error.INVALID_ACTION: This Race action is not available.
race.error.STALE: Race state changed. Refresh before trying again.
race.error.INVALID_INPUT: The roster, compound choices or simulation profile is outside supported limits.
race.error.UNSUPPORTED_VERSION: This saved simulation version is not supported.
race.error.PERSISTENCE_FAILED: Race progress could not be saved. Please try again.
tyre.notice: Tyre development model: one dry stint, no tyre changes. Wear means consumed life: 0% fresh, 100% maximum wear. Long races may reach severe degradation. No pits, traffic/overtaking or weather.
tyre.legacy: Legacy version-1 race: original free-air rules remain active, without tyres. No pit stops, traffic or weather.
tyre.lockedAfterStart: Choose before starting. Compounds are frozen for this race; no tyre changes are available.
tyre.title: Tyre Development Model
traffic.notice: Development race interaction model: explicit track order, dirty air, overtaking and DRS. DRS and traffic indicators describe the last completed lap. Tyre wear means consumed life. No pits, weather or blue flags.
traffic.title: Race interaction model
pit.notice: Development race strategy model: dry tyre stops, stints and track interaction. Pit-cycle position changes are not on-track overtakes. No weather, ERS, incidents or pit-box queues.
pit.semantics: Box requests commit on the next lap advance. The stop occurs after that completed lap, before the following lap. Change or cancel the request before advancing. The tyre-cliff estimate is not a strategy guarantee.
pit.onTrack: On track · no pending pit request
pit.estimate: Estimated pit window: {laps} laps to tyre cliff
pit.ai: Temporary AI strategy: same tyres and pit costs as player cars.
pit.startingNotice: Choose the starting tyres. During the race, request a pit stop to fit a new compound.
command.title: Driver commands
command.timing: Changes apply on the next lap. Negative projected fuel requires saving fuel; insufficient fuel adds a severe lap penalty.
command.ai: AI manages pace, fuel and ERS using the same resources and mechanics.
command.notice: Development race model: pace commands, fuel modes, ERS, dry tyre stops and track interaction. Pit-cycle position changes are not on-track overtakes. Weather, incidents, safety interventions and pit-box queues remain deferred.
weather.title: Weather
weather.DRS_DISABLED_WET: DRS disabled due to wet conditions
weather.uncertainty: Approximate arrival windows and intensity ranges. Conditions between windows may change; this is not the exact weather timeline.
weather.notice: Development weather model: rainfall changes track water gradually. Tyre suitability, temperature and wear drive crossover strategy. Wet conditions may disable DRS. Incidents, safety interventions and final Race UI remain deferred.
incident.notice: Development race: incidents, reliability and Race Control use provisional, deterministic tuning. No red flags or unlapping.
viewer.title: Race operations
viewer.commandPause: Saving a command pauses playback. Resume when both cars are ready.
viewer.positionNote: Position change is relative to the grid, including pit cycles.
viewer.interpolation: Visual positions interpolate saved laps. Timing and classification remain authoritative.
viewer.error: The action could not be completed. Playback is paused. Refresh to load the latest checkpoint before retrying.
viewer.reason.INCIDENT: Your driver had an incident. Playback paused.
viewer.reason.PIT: Your pit stop completed. Playback paused.
viewer.drs.RESTART: DRS disabled · returns in {count} green laps
viewer.tyreLife: Estimated tyre life: ~{count} laps to cliff
viewer.estimateNote: Estimate from current wear and pace mode, not an instruction.
viewer.noCommands.RETIRED: Retired on lap {lap}. Commands are no longer available.
viewer.noCommands.FINISHED: Finished. Commands are no longer available.
viewer.labelNote: Map labels show your cars, their battles and the leader; select any car to identify it.
viewer.phase.seeking: Seeking next strategic event · up to {limit} laps
viewer.reason.COMMAND: Command saved. Playback stays paused — press Resume to continue.
viewer.attention.FUEL: {driver} fuel projected short at the finish
viewer.attention.BATTLE_AHEAD: {driver} in a close battle with the car ahead
